registered.decision_rule: L8-15 is eligible for promotion as an experimental core - promotion itself still requires the operator's explicit go-ahead (D-26) - if and only if, in the L1 run, ALL of the following hold. C0 identity and comparability, settled before any L8-15 output exists: the measured L8-15 weights are the frozen bytes (sha256 in L8_15_EXPECTED.json; per-group FP32 hashes equal to R14's loc8_15 arm); every build and load gate passed; the forward path is the programme's DenseReference (vendored from pilot commit 5b4c22d); the run used the frozen runner and the environment recorded in the freeze, in every invocation; the full decisive instruments were run (no row subset) and no decisive prompt was truncated or skipped; the L1 scorers reproduce every published per-row verdict and count on the anchors' published SELECT-VIEWS-001 and arithmetic-panel predictions, the L1 tokenizer and decoder return every one of those published texts unchanged (encode, decode, strip), and every arithmetic prompt fits the registered 512-token context; and the anchor parity gate, evaluated after both anchors and before L8-15 is loaded, passes: Supa 1.7 reproduces its published SELECT-VIEWS-001 texts on all but max(3, floor(3% of n)) rows, its canonical total within +-3 and its floor verdicts identically; Titan-Sparse does the same and also reproduces arithmetic_permissive and arithmetic_strict each within +-2 and references_retained within +-1 of its published 72, 63 and 41, its correct set on the 47 permissive and 41 strict source-correct rows up to 1 row per policy, its per-class arm_correct and terminated counts within +-1, and its 24 published arithmetic samples in text and termination on all but 3; and both anchors agree with R14's stored first-token log-probabilities on the 228 bridge prompts (top-1 agreement >= 0.99, mean KL(L1||R14) < 0.001 nats). If the anchor parity gate fails, L8-15 is never loaded and no arm generates on the OOD bank. C1 acquisition floors (GATE v2 term 3): on SELECT-VIEWS-001 every family's two-sided exact binomial 95% lower bound on canonical_correct exceeds its published binding floor (ledger_replay 0.2344, prerequisite_plan 0.0781, register_machine 0.0703). C2 acquisition non-inferiority, per family, paired within the run against Titan-Sparse on canonical correctness: in every family the net change (gained - lost) is >= -8 (ledger_replay), >= -5 (prerequisite_plan), >= -6 (register_machine), and no family shows a detected loss (lost > gained with a two-sided exact McNemar p < 0.05). C3 arithmetic (GATE v2 term 1): arithmetic_permissive(L8-15) >= 62 of 150. C4 source answers retained (GATE v2 term 2 plus non-inferiority): references_retained(L8-15) >= 37 of 47 AND >= references_retained(Titan-Sparse, same run) - 2. C5 off-task drift on the 456 fresh prompts: the paired percentile-bootstrap 95% upper bound (10,000 resamples over prompts, seed 20261009) of mean first-token KL(L8-15||Supa) / mean KL(Titan-Sparse||Supa) is < 0.80. C6 out-of-distribution rule extrapolation (amendment A-OOD, D-28(a)), paired within the run against Titan-Sparse on the 600-row OOD bank (docs/l1/ood_bank.jsonl, sha256 recorded in ood_bank.SOURCE.json and pinned in the runner; built with no model call from data that played no part in choosing the cut: six strata of 100 one-step transitions in Titan's trained one-step frame, L_big, L_void, R_wrap, R_boundary, P_inapp and P_appdel), every arm run on it only after the anchor parity gate passed, greedy with at most 96 new tokens, and a row correct iff rcwmt.env.parse_state(family, prediction, lenient=True) equals the oracle state: in every stratum the net change (gained - lost) is >= -max(3, ceil(5% of n)), which is -5 at n = 100, and no stratum shows a detected loss (lost > gained with a two-sided exact McNemar p < 0.05). Supa's OOD scores are report-only. If C0 fails the run is NON-COMPARABLE: no verdict, nothing promoted, no L8-15 endpoint computed, and this registration ends (a rerun is a new registration with a fresh drift draw that may not reuse these prompts, and with a fresh OOD bank if any arm has generated on this one). If C0 holds and any of C1-C6 fails: DO NOT PROMOTE. Long context and literal UNKNOWN (including every parity and scorer check on that SPENT bank), Supa's arithmetic against its CPU-measured source answers, the legacy per-class monitor and the bridge drift ratio are report-only and never enter C0-C6. No threshold may change after any L1 output exists.
